sentences.text:
Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Borulkar Avinash R.
 App for Respondent-State : Mr. S. B. Joshi

.....
 Coram : V. K. Jadhav, J.
 Dated : 8th July, 2019

Per Court:-
 1.
Heard both sides.
2. By order dated 19.06.2019, learned APP was directed to take  instructions from the Investigating Officer in respect of the  antecedents of the applicant.
Though the co-accused has disclosed  the name of the present applicant, however, there is no further  connecting evidence as against the applicant.
Learned APP, on  instructions, submits that the Investigating Officer has taken search  in various police stations, including the police station at  Bhokardan.
However, no crime has been registered against the  applicant anywhere.

It thus appears that the antecedents of the Arshad S/O. Basharath Baig Mirza vs The State Of Maharashtra on 8 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190981669/
1  applicant are clear.

sentences.text:
Thus, considering the entire aspect of the case,
::: Uploaded on - 09/07/2019 ::: Downloaded on - 10/07/2019 03:06:55 ::
 22-ABA-667-2019  -2-  I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant with certain  conditions.

Hence, the following order:
 ORDER I.
The application is hereby allowed.

II. In the event of arrest of the applicant ARSHAD S/O. BASHARATH BAIG MIRZA in connection with crime no. 58 of 2019 registered with Phulambri Police Station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 r/w 34 of IPC and under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees fifteen thousand only) with one surety of the like amount on the following conditions;
a.
The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b. The applicant shall attend the concerned police station as and when required by the Investigating Officer.
III. The application is accordingly disposed of.

( V. K. JADHAV, J.) vre/
Arshad S/O. Basharath Baig Mirza vs The State Of Maharashtra on 8 July, 2019
